title: PCB V0.1 Validation
objective: Verify the first PCB revision against the schematic, footprints, and bring-up expectations.
hypothesis: V0.1 can be validated with continuity checks, power rail checks, and a small firmware smoke test.
test_plan: Inspect the board, log continuity, measure rails, then run a safe smoke test with the minimum firmware.
setup_notes: Board received with first-pass assembly notes and a short bring-up checklist.
lesson_learned: A short checklist prevents avoidable first-power mistakes.
